_comment: Art prompts for No. 21. Final version, 2026-11-02: Andy compared the set with the No. 20 prints he framed, and each picture's background was cleared in its original ChatGPT chat ('keep the subject exactly as drawn, plain clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2') so the subjects stayed. Prompts below describe the finished pictures. Optimized to public/assets/spots/no21_<file> at 900 px, JPEG q84.
suffix: Predominantly crisp black ink linework with stipple dots and cross-hatch shading, strong contrast, slight engraving texture, restrained accents in muted pine green and rust red. Charming and specific, not generic. Hand-drawn local newspaper engraving, not a photograph, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.

ambc-fall-fest.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a mountain biker in mid-air throwing a sideways whip off a dirt jump, seen from slightly below and in front so the bike is tilted nearly flat and the rider's grinning face under a full-face helmet is turned toward us, cropped so rider and bike fill the frame edge to edge. Knobby tires, dust flying off the rear wheel, a rust-red jersey, one knee tucked, both hands locked on the bars. Behind it, nothing but plain, clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2, so the subject pops off the page.
ambc-fall-fest.note: The first ChatGPT rider, kept at Andy's request, with its teal moved to pine in post.

latin-knox-printshop.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling young woman DJ with dark curly hair dancing a little as she works her decks, one hand on the mixer and the other raised to the music, seen from the front across the decks, cropped from the waist up and large in the frame. Big hoop earrings, a pine green top, headphones around her neck. Behind it, nothing but plain, clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2, so the subject pops off the page.

808-college-night.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young man with shaggy blond hair singing into a microphone on a stand while playing a Telecaster-style electric guitar, cropped from the chest up and seen from his right side as he leans into the mic. Mouth open mid-note, eyes nearly shut, a band tee, a guitar strap over the shoulder, the headstock crossing the lower corner, large in the frame. Behind it, nothing but plain, clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2, so the subject pops off the page.

sokno-sourdough-first-friday.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young, earthy baker with curly brown hair piled in a messy bun and a warm smile, lifting a big crusty sourdough loaf out at her counter, cropped from the waist up and large in the frame. An olive green t-shirt, flour on her hands. Behind it, one single light wooden shelf with two loaves, and otherwise plain, clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2, so the subject pops off the page.
sokno-sourdough-first-friday.note: Trial wording, 2026-11-02: after the subject and background, 'Hand-drawn and a little rough, with simple shapes and not too much fine detail' was added to the locked style; not locked yet.

cut-corners-fbn.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a dancer with a shaved head and a wide-open laughing mouth, arms thrown up and crossed above the head, caught mid-bounce with sweat flying, cropped from the ribs up and seen straight on. goat-yoga-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a small black-and-white goat with a tiny rust bow tie standing calmly on the back of a woman in tabletop pose on a yoga mat, the woman with short red hair smiling gently with her eyes closed, seen from the side and cropped close so the goat and the woman are large in the frame. wilderness-basics.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: two hands striking a ferro rod with a knife spine so a shower of sparks falls onto a nest of dry tinder, the first small flame just catching, with a young woman's focused face with a dark ponytail leaning in above her hands, cropped close so the hands, the sparks and the tinder fill the lower two thirds of the frame.
